title: Lehmer's totient problem with fewer than sixteen prime factors — submission package

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India

description:
Lehmer's totient problem with fewer than sixteen prime factors. Hexagon/Overleaf and Mathematics of Computation submission preparation, version 1.6.0. The reviewed folder Paper_5 package contains the article PDF, a minimal compilable TeX ZIP, AI provenance, Hexagon fields, journal details, an unsent cover letter with editable source, and an author-prepared AI disclosure. All PDFs have no row or margin line numbers. No journal submission or acceptance is claimed.

The research revision establishes the stated sixteen-prime-factor lower bound and companion-equation results through written finite reductions and computations. It adds a one-candidate reduction for each prime prefix and independently checked primality certificates. Lehmer's full totient conjecture remains open.

Verification scope: The repository contains partial Lean results for statements not depending on the exhaustive search. The full searches and the full Lehmer conjecture are not claimed to be Lean-formalised.

Original preprint: https://hexagonmath.org/2610.00454v1. Earlier manuscript/source DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23617604. Original attribution and component licences are preserved. Human-understanding and mixed-text declarations record the submitting author's explicit statement on 25 October 2026. The standalone AI declaration is author-prepared, not an official signed publisher form.
notes: Component licence notices in the original repository remain authoritative. The article is already available under the existing Hexagon CC BY 4.0 record. New package DOI is assigned by Zenodo after the GitHub release; no earlier DOI is reused as the new release DOI.
